drift_points.actual: When the envvar is unset, Option.resolve_envvar_value returns None, so Parameter.consume_value falls through to ctx.lookup_default (ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP) and then self.get_default (ParameterSource.DEFAULT) — the envvar layer itself never blocks the default

drift_points.expected: The default should be used as the fallback when the env var is unset; the prompt should fire only when no source provides a value
drift_points.actual: Option.consume_value prompts whenever the resolved source is None or ParameterSource.DEFAULT, self.prompt is set, and (self.required or self.prompt_required) holds — so once a prompt is configured, a value that came from the option default is treated as unset and the user is prompted anyway. prompt_required=False is the knob that restores default-as-fallback
override_chain: Option.consume_value -> super().consume_value -> prompt gate on source in {None, ParameterSource.DEFAULT} -> prompt_for_value
